signals.title: Racing to Sustain Jevons' Paradox
signals.description: Hyperscalers declared AI capacity-constrained on Q2 2026 calls. HBM3e memory rose 20% & HBM4 is forecast to double, while B200 spot rentals have held flat. Model makers are segmenting into premium, mid-market, & value tiers to keep Jevons' paradox alive through the coming shock.
signals.thesis: The article discusses the challenges of sustaining AI growth due to capacity constraints, but does not mention a specific company.

signals.title: AI is a Terrible Ghostwriter
signals.description: In the age of slop, readers test authenticity. I lace posts with subliminal sincerity — the ampersand, neologisms, grammatical plumes, mimicry. Then AI edits it all. I've never had a ghost writer, but I did have a human editor. Was that any different?
signals.thesis: The article discusses the limitations of AI in content creation, particularly in terms of authenticity and human touch.
